recipe.visualDefinition: A watercolor-style illustration featuring a red wooden barn with an open garage door revealing a music studio setup, paired with a classic red pickup truck in the foreground. The scene is set against a soft sunset sky within a textured cream border, topped with bold, condensed serif typography.
coreVisualRelationships: The red barn acts as the central architectural anchor for the composition.
The red truck in the lower right balances the large title text in the upper half.
The open garage door creates a focal point of interior detail within the exterior landscape.
The cream border frames the entire scene, providing a vintage paper aesthetic.
coreInvariants: Red-dominant color palette for primary subjects
Watercolor wash texture across all illustrated elements
Condensed, high-contrast serif typeface for the main title
Rough, hand-painted edges on the inner frame

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: The barn is centered and large-scale; the truck is positioned in the lower right foreground; the title occupies the top third of the frame.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The red barn and the dark opening of the garage door.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Eyes start at the large red title, move down to the barn, follow the truck's line to the right, and settle on the small oval logo at the bottom center.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: The cream-colored border and the light ground provide breathing room around the dense red subjects.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Barn Red (primary subjects and title text)
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Sunset Yellow and Sky Blue (background atmosphere and instrument details)
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High saturation in the reds against desaturated, high-value neutrals.

letterConstructionRules: Consistent stroke weight with slight modulation
characterSpecificRedesigns: Tight kerning to create a solid block of color
Subtle drop shadow to lift text from the background
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: A large condensed serif for the title paired with a small, clean sans-serif or slab-serif inside a pill-shaped badge at the bottom.
graphicDevices: Pill-shaped red badge for secondary text

candidateDirections.reason: Similar sharp serifs and classic feel

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Create a watercolor illustration of a red wooden barn with an open garage door showing a drum set and guitar inside. A red vintage pickup truck is parked to the right. The background features a soft yellow sunset. The entire image is enclosed in a rough-edged cream paper border.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add a large, condensed red serif title across the top, slightly overlapping the barn's roof. Add a small red oval badge at the bottom center containing secondary text in a simple white font.

verificationChecks: Is the barn the central focus?
Does the watercolor texture feel consistent across the truck and barn?
Is the title text condensed and bold?
Is the cream border present with a hand-painted edge?

adjustableVariables: Specific model of the red truck
postGenerationChecks: Ensure the truck and barn share the same red hue.
Check that the text shadow is subtle and not distracting.
Verify the instruments inside the garage are recognizable but stylized.
Confirm the border does not have perfectly straight digital lines.
recipe.reuseFormula: Watercolor Barn Scene + Condensed Serif Title + Vintage Truck + Cream Border Frame
